(Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This plugin shares the same ancestry as the company's `Nonead-Universal-Robots-MCP` (see "Reference "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"implementation" below). It exposes the "control a UR robot with AI" capability as **native DSH tools"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"**: the plugin starts a persistent Python worker (which internally reuses the vendored `URBasic` lib"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rary), and tools talk to the robot through that worker. After a single `connect`, you can keep issui"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ng commands to the same IP."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`dsh-nonead-ursim` gives a DSH agent a **Universal Robots arm it can drive in plain language** — the"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"
complete tool surface of a UR controller (89 `ursim_*` tools: joint and Cartesian motion,
multi-seg"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ment continuous sequences, OptiMove,
drawing primitives, pose and status readback, RTDE telemetry, s"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"tandard/tool I/O and registers,
URScript, TCP/payload/tool settings, force mode, conveyor tracking),"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" plus a live **3D simulation
panel** that renders the same joint data those tools read."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Out of the box it drives an **offline, kinematics-level virtual UR robot** on the reserved loopback
"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"address `127.0.0.1`: no hardware, no real controller, nothing to install beyond Python — start a
sim"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ulation and issue commands. A real controller is addressed only after you ask for it explicitly
(`mo"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"tionMode: 'real'` plus a `realRobotIps` allow-list), and the motion approval gate is **off by
defaul"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"t** (since 0.2.3; set `requireApprovalForMotion: true` to turn it on)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"What the simulation models and what it does not is a deliberate, stated boundary: **motion is real
k"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"inematics**; **telemetry is estimated** and labelled as such; **I/O and registers are in-memory
stat"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"e**; anything that genuinely needs a controller (force mode, safety-status bits, program load and
ex"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ecution, raw scripts, conveyor) answers `SIM_UNSUPPORTED` instead of pretending. It is **not** a
saf"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ety-assessment tool — there is no dynamics and no safety function — so cycle time, collision and
saf"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ety-distance questions stay outside its scope."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Feature overview"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**89** tools (`ursim_*`) in total."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Category | Tool(s) (`ursim_*`) | Description |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Connection | `ursim_connect` / `ursim_disconnect` | Connect / disconnect a UR robot by IP |
| Stat"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"us | `ursim_get_status` | One-shot read of TCP, joints, model, serial, version, safety mode, run/pro"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"gram state, voltage, current, temperatures, uptime, joint currents/voltages/speeds, TCP speed and wr"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ench, speed scaling |
| Pose | `ursim_get_tcp_pose` / `ursim_get_joint_pose` | Read current TCP pose"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" / joint angles |
| Targets | `ursim_get_target_values` | Read **where the controller is *taking* th"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"e arm**: target joint positions/velocities/accelerations and target TCP pose/speed, plus the matchin"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"g actual values for comparison. Comes from the RTDE `target_*` fields (part of the receive recipe si"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"nce before 0.1.0), so it is free — and it is the only direct evidence for "command sent but not exec"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"uted yet / being blended / held back by the safety limit" |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **`python/ur_worker.py`** — a persistent stdio JSON worker. It keeps `ROBOTS` / `ROBOT_MODELS` dic"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ts, connects by IP, and runs one command per call. Motion commands use (bounded) "arrival confirmati"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"on" polling and return a structured error on failure.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Notes / limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Connection persistence** — the worker process lives for the plugin's lifetime and keeps robot co"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nnections by IP; after a worker crash or a DSH restart you must `connect` again.
- **Remote control "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"mode** — some UR robots must be in "remote control" before they execute motion/program commands, and"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" `ursim_connect` reports that state. **CB3 robots running URSoftware 3.1 through 3.20 already allow "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"remote control by default (nothing to enable at the settings level)**; a `remote_control: false` rea"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ding still means the controller is *currently* not in remote mode — in local/teach-pendant mode URSc"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ript and motion commands are silently discarded, so switch the pendant to remote control. Other firm"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"ware (e-Series, or CB3 outside that range) needs Remote Control enabled in PolyScope first. `ursim_g"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"et_status` also reports `remote_control_raw`, and an unreadable state is reported as unknown rather "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"than pretended to be `false`.
- **Tool digital I/O** — `ursim_get_digital_in` / `ursim_set_digital_o"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"ut` with `which="tool"` control the tool-flange digital I/O. Tool digital signals are **not carried "},{"id":"p21s12","text":"by RTDE**, so reading a tool input runs a short URScript program (via `SendProgram`) that may **inte"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"rrupt a running program**; writing a tool output sends the URScript `write_tool_digital_out` command"},{"id":"p21s14","text":". Tool digital **output read-back is not supported** (no reliable `read_tool_digital_out` expression"},{"id":"p21s15","text":").
- **Joint current** — the current RTDE recipe does not expose per-joint current directly, so `urs"},{"id":"p21s16","text":"im_get_joint_current` is not provided (the reference implementation's version of this tool has a val"},{"id":"p21s17","text":"ue bug; this implementation does not carry it over).
- **Threading / cancel** — motion commands poll"},{"id":"p21s18","text":" until arrival within `commandTimeoutMs`; for long trajectories, remind the model in the prompt to s"},{"id":"p21s19","text":"et a reasonable timeout or split the motion into steps.
- **Not a safety boundary** — this plugin is"},{"id":"p21s20","text":" on par with the `bash` tool and can drive physical equipment; test thoroughly on a real robot befor"},{"id":"p21s21","text":"e production use.
